status: Implemented and verified; P3-T6-T8 and Phase acceptance pending

followup.note: Run after adding final_interrupted to recovery eligibility and the final-timeout regression. Eight cases overlap the full suite; one is new. No claim that all 536 ran in one invocation.

tests.source_timing: The 535-case full suite was collected before the final_interrupted whitelist fix and its extra test. The nine-case follow-up verifies that final fix. CLI help text was also clarified.

implemented: Explicit workflow-resume and read-only advisory recovery assessment in workflow-status
Durable active-step cursor and separate idempotent recovery events while original attempt observations remain unchanged
Retry only requests proven unsent by the durable pre-transmission dispatch protocol; preserve uncertain calls without automatic redispatch
Reuse complete saved Developer/Reviewer responses after original input, schema, approved policy, event stream, session, hash and validation checks
Inspect every partial-patch file against exact approved-before/proposed-after hashes; preserve unexpected edits and skip already-applied writes
Reconcile PID/creation identity and named kill-on-close Job descendants before rerunning interrupted task or final validation
Preserve original authorization, shared correction budget, completed failures and finding identities through repeated interruptions
Block concurrent ownership and alternate-state takeover when the previous database is active, missing or corrupt
Inert AI launch gate before durable dispatch; atomic AppContainer Job assignment during process creation

verification.forced_process_boundaries: Real subprocess controllers exit before dispatch, after saved responses, during partial writes, before/after finding ingestion and during actual AppContainer validation. Repeated recovery interruption is also tested.
verification.response_proof: Missing/truncated/modified artifacts, failed/tool-using events, duplicate sessions and stale Reviewer context reject reuse. Original timing and audit records are retained; unknown durations remain null.
verification.partial_files: Exact before/after mixtures can finish; unexpected edits, including a separate editor process racing compare-and-write, are preserved. Already-applied file mtimes are unchanged.
verification.process_safety: Actual launch-gate/controller death and descendant cleanup; AppContainer death immediately after CreateProcess and before ResumeThread; live descendant blocks without termination; PID reuse/inspection uncertainty block appropriately.
verification.validation: Actual AppContainer validation is forcibly interrupted and rerun before final validation. Separate real contained timeout regression covers final_interrupted eligibility. Known completed failures retain correction/stop decisions.
verification.ownership: Existing real competing-runner tests remain passing; added missing/corrupt/missing-schema previous-store guards preserve ownership metadata.
verification.git_metadata: Disposable .git directory and .git-file fixtures alter metadata only; recovery succeeds with identical application content. No Git operation is performed by these scenarios.
verification.terminal_states: Cancelled and failed runs remain terminal; completed live resume adds no calls or events.
verification.ai_transport: Regression role outputs use deterministic local subprocess fixtures. Actual AI-service evidence is separated below; generated application checks run in standard-user AppContainer.

notes: One Task on a fresh external disposable fixture, controller-authored plan and actual two-test baseline; no Planner service call.
Actual Developer response saved, controller os._exit(99), explicit reuse without redispatch, then one separate actual Reviewer.
Task and final checks each passed eight tests; six independent requirement cases passed on a copy of the final application.
Cached short-path preverified validator used by the live script; production default per-attempt storage is covered by the full regression.
This is bounded T5 recovery evidence, not P3-T7 user acceptance or fixed runner A.

remaining_work: P3-T6 reports, feedback and final reuse/user acceptance gates
limits: A sent/uncertain request without a complete verified saved response remains blocked; there is no automatic provider-history lookup or blind retry.
Legacy interrupted boundaries without the durable active_step cursor require inspection.
Unexpected partial bytes or user edits are preserved and require inspection; arbitrary snapshots are never adopted.
Finished environmental/specification/incomplete-validation failures retain their stop; recovery does not convert them to success or silently reopen cancelled/failed runs.
Read-only recovery_status is advisory; workflow-resume rechecks under exclusive ownership before changing anything.
The reviewed UTF-8 create/replace and Python/pytest dependency scope is unchanged; deletion/rename and dependency installation are unsupported.
No administrator setup, global ACL/firewall/account change, user Phase acceptance, fixed runner A, commit or push is performed.
